fusions.name: All in Good Time
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Plodding Shove
fusions.desc: Shoulders forward through a cone 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 14 seconds and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Unhurried Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
